name: Worm Tower
desc:
Welcome to Worm Tower

🍏 Eat Apples to grow your body length!
🚧 Use your length to bridge gaps and avoid falling.
🏁 Reach the Green Flag to win the level!
🧠 Solve challenging puzzles to unlock new stages.
🛠️All stages are tested and 100% possible!

👍 LIKE, ⭐ FAVORITE and JOIN our group for a FREE SKIP STAGE!
Playable with PC, Mobile, Tablet or Console
